04 / SERVICES

Music services shaped around the project.

Music production

Full production for singles, albums, creator projects, and visual media, from the first demo through the final arrangement.

Original composition

Original themes, cues, and scores for games, videos, campaigns, and other visual work.

Mixing & mastering

Detailed mixes and masters built to translate clearly across listening systems.

Vocal production

Vocal comping, tuning, arranging, and processing that support the performance.

Arrangement

Song structure and instrumentation that strengthen the pacing, dynamics, and emotional direction.

Sound design

Custom textures, transitions, and sounds created to fit the identity of each project.

05 / ABOUT

I make music with range and intention.

I’m Joshua King, a self-taught music producer and composer with more than eight years of experience. I work across pop, hip-hop, orchestral, R&B, electronic, cinematic, lo-fi, and other genres. That range lets me meet each project where it is instead of forcing it into one sound.

I collaborate with independent artists, content creators, and game developers, handling everything from early direction and composition to the final mix and master.

Human-made from start to finish.

All of my music is human-composed and produced. I do not use AI generation in my musical work.
